name: koubek-plugins
description: Jakub Vaňák's Claude Code plugins: Business Central on Linux inside Docker sandboxes, and companions; a review flow for any repository.

plugins.name: bc-linux
plugins.description: Run a real Business Central (NST + SQL) inside an sbx sandbox with Docker and drive it with the bcl CLI: instances, snapshots, compile, publish, AL test runners.

plugins.name: npcore-bc-linux
plugins.description: NpCore / NP Retail companion to bc-linux: the verified recipe for NP Retail + NP Retail Tests on a local BC28/BC29.

plugins.name: review-flow
plugins.description: Review each topic before Claude commits it, with effort that follows how critical the change is: a REVIEW.md per project, the review-change and review-setup skills, and a git gate that refuses Claude's unreviewed commits.
